name: Arrowhead Day Camp
description_short: Traditional day camp in West Chester, running since 1956, for boys and girls ages 4 to 13. Tuition covers door to door busing, lunch and snacks, daily swim lessons in four heated pools and dozens of activities from archery and boating on the camp lake to gymnastics, zip line and tennis.
refund_policy_summary: A $500 deposit holds a spot; all but $100 of it is refundable until March 15, 2027. Full tuition is due April 30, 2027.
swim_waterfront_notes: Each camper takes a swim test on day one and gets lessons in groups of 6 to 12 by ability across four heated pools, plus daily free swim; colored bands mark depth limits. The camp also has a man made fresh water lake for boating and fishing.
notes: 2027 tuition: 8 weeks $6,545; 7 weeks $6,125; any 6 weeks $5,600; any 5 weeks $4,975; any 4 weeks $4,545; first or last 4 consecutive weeks $4,245. Horseback riding twice a week is extra ($350 to $450). These rates apply to deposits received before December 1, 2026; later deposits pay a higher Tier 2 rate that the page does not list. Tuition includes door to door transportation, lunch and snacks; families who drive (9:30 drop off, 3:00 pick up) get $100 a week off, and meeting at a bus stop takes $50 a week off. Extended day 7:30 to 5:30 at no extra cost. Sibling and referral discounts. Dates are tentative pending school snow days.
